analysis.reason: Test expected a successful 200 response for a valid product ID (ID 1). The API returned 404 with body {"message":"Requested item not found"}, indicating the service did not return the expected product data.
analysis.recommendedAction: Verify that product with ID 1 exists in the test data/DB and that the product service is reachable. Reproduce the request (e.g., curl) and check API/service logs for why the item was not found. If the product was removed intentionally, update test data or test expectation; otherwise, fix the backend to return 200 and the expected ProductResponse payload and headers.
